name: netintel
description: Pay-per-call network, domain, web and inference lookups for agents — DNS, SSL, WHOIS, IP reputation, email verification, web fetch & search, OpenAI-compatible gateway, embeddings, market data — in USDC over x402. No API keys, and the plugin never holds a key or signs a payment: each paid call is handed, with its exact price, to the agent's own wallet (AgentCash, Coinbase Agentic Wallet or Coinbase Wallet MCP).
